contracts.description: Terminal invitation-review state. On a successful refresh, if the received request is no longer pending, clear the preview and show this state. Do not receive it again automatically or retain Accept/Decline. Unrelated Friends/Invitations actions remain usable; another review link starts its own receive flow. Do not show this review-specific notice on other Friends tabs.

Verified Spotify identity is required. On the authentication logout signal, synchronously clear Friends inventories, secrets, review and decision state before waiting for session work to drain or auth storage to change. Ignore old completions. Use this canonical state while the route is still mounted; account actions eventually navigate to Login.
